scope: Read-only code/history, four official sources, GitHub workflow states and stubbed parser fixtures; no scheduling or live data collection activated.

officialSources.title: Elexon Insights developer portal
officialSources.finding: Public Insights APIs require no API key; use governed by BMRS data licence and API terms. Do not import older BMRS/MSID key requirements into this API.

officialSources.title: PV_Live v4.1 user guide
officialSources.finding: Preferred hostname api.pvlive.uk; period30minutes; UTC fields; updated_gmt permits revision checks; default latest-only if bounds absent. Estimates exclude directly metered Solar BMUs. Preserve nulls and bounded requests.

officialSources.title: Sheffield Solar PV_Live

officialSources.title: Elexon Insights documentation
officialSources.finding: Published API data and documents require source acknowledgement according to BMRS data licence; retain terms URL and attribution in producer manifest.

findings.finding: Monolith collector names weekly/daily do not imply automatic polling: inspected workflows expose workflow_dispatch only. Last schedule freeze commit a0782f1ebce3467d1a5c1bec21260698d6c7ff5c explicitly froze workflows to manual dispatch. GitHub state active means enabled for manual invocation, not scheduled.

Federated data-gb-electricity has monthly cron17 6 2 * *, closed-month gap filling, frozen existing months, explicit bounded repair. A weekly cron alone would still wait for closed months and therefore not deliver fresh within-month weeks.
Original PV daily parser drops dictionary0MW, accepts Infinity and accepts returned timestamp outside requested day. Stub-only fixture saved separately. Repair before enabling ingestion.

PV daily aggregation averages returned values without complete interval/day validation. Wrong query aliases in fallback can receive latest-only records; independently reproduced wrong-day acceptance. Existing output must not be relabelled verified daily energy.
PV legacy code uses old Sheffield hostname; official guide prefers api.pvlive.uk. Change endpoint contract in a new producer, keep original immutable.

Elexon generation/prices stay data-gb-electricity; PVLive should be a separate dataset namespace in that producer or a designated PV owner once user chooses. No dedicated local PV producer was found in inspected checkouts. Pipeline/Atlas consume compact pinned manifests, never browser-fetch provider APIs.
GB is not UK/NI. Provisional FUELINST, FUELHH and embedded PV estimates are distinct series; do not merge by technology label or double-count Solar BMUs.

weeklyArchitecture.cadence: One bounded weekly ingestion job per owner, proposed not activated
weeklyArchitecture.grain: Retain source intervals independently: FUELINST provisional five-minute observations per existing source register; FUELHH and PV thirty-minute intervals. Weekly is collection cadence, not measurement grain.
weeklyArchitecture.recentLane: Separate provisional recent-window partitions or revisioned snapshots for complete UTC weeks; preserve closed-month immutable historical lane. Explicit reconciliation promotes/revises by declared key, never silent overwrite.
keys: source revision or published/updated timestamp retained separately
weeklyArchitecture.aggregation: Energy MWh=sum(valid interval-average MW ? duration_hours) only where semantics support interval averages. Do not integrate provisional point samples without a declared method. Mean power is duration-weighted over covered intervals; missing intervals remain missing. Publish expected/observed count, covered duration and incomplete status.
weeklyArchitecture.calendar: UTC week boundaries with explicit half-open intervals; convert GB settlement periods using calendar helper, including46/48/50period DSTdays. UTC has48half-hour intervals per full day.
weeklyArchitecture.budgets: Seven-day window plus explicit bounded revision lookback, finite retry/backoff and response bytes; last-known-good manifest survives provider outage; no synthetic fresh zero data.
weeklyArchitecture.rights: Pin terms/attribution and source URL/retrieval date separately from code licence. No paid or authenticated provider calls initiated in this study.
proofs: zero is not missing; nonfinite rejected
source units and price basis cannot be merged
manifest hash and actual served projection equality
